work.description: Fragment witness; the source omits part of the act. The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent LXXII has clean protocol54422–54423, surviving occasion-specific provincial statutes54441–54504, full own confirmation54506–54554 and terminal clauses, dating54598–54603 and subscription54605 before LXXIII54608. Fragment extent: the marked studii54448 is followed by a missing governing study-obligation predicate in the narrated statutory provision54447–54459; historical note54477–54479 explicitly says Aliqiiid deesl and proposes theology-study wording and duration. The absent wording has no extant physical LF range or determinable length; its locus is after54448, before the continuation54449. This missing substantive statutory requirement is the sole blocker to a complete-act edition. Substantial other statutes and the own confirming disposition survive and are useful, attributed and bounded. Admit only this surviving fragment54415–54605 with its explicit lacuna note; preserve the source conjecture as apparatus, do not insert it or expand its etc.54479. Fragment-policy distinction: this is not classified from a merely tentative single-word variant. The relative provision in quibus religiosi studentes54446–54448 has no governing predicate stating what study obligation follows the prior triennium before the sicuti reference54449–54454 and resulting eligibility54455–54459. The source itself marks that locus and reports Aliqiiid deesl54477. The missing study-obligation portion and its duration cannot be determined from the surviving words; the editor’s example is preserved only as conjectural apparatus. By contrast, tentative lexical gestare in the enclosed Leo X text29698 does not remove the present outer confirmation of unit0018, which remains admitted with disclosure.
